name: @isthislegit/mobile
description: Android client for a self-hosted isthislegit server

autolinking.//: react-native-gesture-handler arrives as a transitive dependency of expo-router, which needs it for drawer navigation and the JavaScript stack. This app uses neither -- it is a native stack -- and the library is not in the JS bundle at all: the only two mentions of it in a release bundle's sourcemap are comments. Excluding it here stops it being linked and built natively. That is worth doing because its C++ codegen produces object-file paths around 289 characters, and the ninja shipped inside the NDK's CMake 3.22.1 refuses any path over 260 with a hard-coded check of its own -- before Windows is ever asked, so enabling long paths does not help and neither does relocating the project. The hamburger menu in src/components/Drawer.tsx is deliberately built on Modal and Animated rather than on expo-router's drawer navigator so that this entry can stay; the bottom sheets and the lightbox's pinch are hand-rolled for the same reason. Remove this entry only with the path problem in hand.
